npmscan.description: npmscan remote MCP server (streamable HTTP, read-only, no account or API key). Free. Checks npm packages before install: known malware and vulnerabilities per version (OSV, GitHub advisories), maintainer and publisher changes, publish provenance against the source repo, and install-script analysis; also audits package.json and lockfiles. Sends only the package names and versions you look up. Docs: https://npmscan.com/mcp
